research_question: Can a compact residual student trained from frozen P1n supervision replace UNet inference while retaining at least 90 percent of the teacher recall gain under cell-wise FPR control?

student.input: frozen 256-D MLCNN embedding plus shared raw-physics isrj_periodicity and main ISRJ logit
student.architecture: LayerNorm, 192-D MLP, bounded residual-logit head plus changed-event auxiliary head
student.loss: truth BCE + 0.5 soft-teacher BCE + 0.25 changed-event BCE

threshold_selection: training-selection identities only; maximize mean recall with every regime-power observed FPR<=0.08 and CP95<=0.15
next_if_pass: Freeze the student, add predicted-gate twelve-parameter metrics, then benchmark batch1/64 FLOPs, memory and latency on two untouched identity seeds.
stop_rule: If the compact student fails, do not tune on development seed580000000; reassess whether the P1n gain is intrinsically tied to separated-waveform information.
